title.zh: Linea Exits Yield Boost Validators After MetaMask Security Incident, Says Vault Funds Unaffected
title.en: Linea Exits Yield Boost Validators After MetaMask Security Incident, Says Vault Funds Unaffected

current_state.zh: Linea has pulled out of Yield Boost validator operations following a MetaMask security incident, while maintaining that funds in its vaults were not affected.
